name: Sightreader Public-Domain Piano Catalog
purpose: Seed manifest for app-side score discovery, download and MusicXML analysis.
design_principles: Catalog metadata and score-derived metadata are kept separate.
Unknown score-derived values are null, never guessed.
The app ingestion pipeline should preserve source URL, license evidence, file hash and parser version.
For sight-reading, segments should later be generated from full scores and analyzed independently.

collections.title: 24 Petits préludes, Op.9

source.license: Public domain score available via provider

collections.notes: Best first systematic 24-key set; app ingestion should determine printed numbering and all score-derived metrics.

collections.title: 160 Kurze Übungen, Op.821
collections.coverage: short exercises; collection described as spanning all major/minor keys

source.license: Public domain score available via provider

collections.notes: Especially useful for short sight-reading units. Do not assign key/range metadata until score ingestion.

collections.title: 48 Études en forme de préludes, Op.161

source.license: Public domain score available via provider

collections.notes: Useful second layer after Op.821; score metrics pending.

collections.title: Preludes and Exercises, Op.43

source.license: Public domain score available via provider

collections.notes: Strong tonal warm-up source; exact item boundaries should be derived during ingestion.

source.license: Repository describes library as public-domain MusicXML; verify per asset during ingestion

collections.notes: Preferred machine-readable discovery source. Ingestion should retain per-file repository path and commit/hash.

collections.title: OpenScore Lieder Corpus
collections.coverage: art songs; useful selectively for piano textures/fragments

source.license: CC0

collections.notes: Not primary warm-up corpus because scores include voice, but valuable later for accompaniment/sight-reading textures.
